officialName: Representation for Opposition to Grant of Patent
purpose: File a pre-grant representation by way of opposition to the grant of a patent, in respect of a published application, stating the representor's particulars and the grounds.

fee.note: No fee is indicated on the face of Form 7A. Pre-grant representation under Rule 55 is historically without fee — confirm against the current First Schedule before relying on this.

layout.notes: Two-column form: left column carries the numbered instructions (1-5); right column carries the running representation with inline blanks. Structurally parallel to Form 7 but for a PUBLISHED APPLICATION (there is no granted patent number yet). Form 7A prints no 'Dated this...' line.

sections.title: Representor Particulars
sections.description: Instruction 1: state the names, address and nationality of the representor(s). The representor is usually a third party.

autofill.derivation: Choose 'I' for a single representor, 'We' for multiple.

fields.label: Names, address and nationality of the representor(s)
fields.helpText: Full name(s) (family/principal name first), complete address incl postal index no./code and state, and nationality.

validation.message: Enter the representor's name, address and nationality.

sections.title: Application Being Opposed
sections.description: Pre-printed: 'hereby give representation by way of opposition to the grant of patent in respect of application no ...... dated ...... made by ...... and published on ......'

fields.text: hereby give representation by way of opposition to the grant of patent in respect of application no

validation.patternMessage: Expected an IPO application number, e.g. 202211012345 or 1234/DEL/2015.

validation.message: Enter the applicant of the opposed application.

fields.label: Published on (date)
fields.helpText: Date of publication of the application under section 11A (from the patent gazette / publication record).

sections.title: Grounds
sections.description: Instruction 2: state the grounds one after another.

sections.title: Address for Service in India
sections.description: Instruction 3: complete address incl postal index number/code and state along with telephone and fax number.

fields.label: My/our address for service in India
fields.helpText: Must be an address in India. Include postal index no./code, state, and telephone and fax number.

validation.message: Enter an address for service in India.

sections.title: To be signed by the opponent or by his/her authorized registered patent agent.
Name and designation of the natural person who has signed.
sections.description: Form 7A asks for name AND designation, unlike Form 7 (name only).

fields.label: Name of the natural person who has signed

validation.message: Enter the full name of the natural person who signed.

fields.text:
To
The Controller of Patents,
The Patent Office,
at

autofill.derivation: Jurisdictional patent office based on the representor's address or the office handling the published application.

attachments.label: Statement and evidence in support of the representation
attachments.note: Typically accompanies the representation, though not enumerated as a field on the form face.

notes: Note. - Strike out whichever is not applicable (I/We, My/our, his/her).
Form 7A is the PRE-GRANT representation (published application, no patent number); Form 7 is the POST-GRANT opposition (granted patent number).
Form 7A asks for the name AND designation of the natural person who has signed.
No 'Dated this...' line is printed on Form 7A; the signing date is recorded at application level, not as a printed field.

printedHeader.statute: THE PATENTS ACT, 1970 (39 of 1970) and THE PATENTS RULES, 2003
printedHeader.subject: REPRESENTATION FOR OPPOSITION TO GRANT OF PATENT
